subentry.2017.description: Configure general settings which will influence the behavior of other modules and components within the application.
subentry.2018.description: Configure the patient and sample demographics fields used within the application.
subentry.2020.description: Configure which details about patients and visits are available within the 'Patients administration' module.
subentry.2022.description: Define alarms triggered by an instrument flag (if non-default alarms are to be used).
subentry.2023.description: Map flags sent by the devices with the alarms as defined in the Instrument alarm definition screen.
subentry.2024.description: Map result-related alarms created by the application with each device type and assign an alarm severity and a result type (patient or QC).
subentry.2025.description: Set up comments and comment codes to simplify and standardize commenting. Comments defined in this screen will be available in all screens where predefined comments can be added.
subentry.2026.description: Define and manage the various types of samples to be tested.
subentry.2027.description: Define and manage tubes used for analysis of samples.
subentry.2028.description: Add a new test definition or edit parameters such as the full test name or the measurement unit that is used with a test. This is necessary to align the settings with the ones used in your organization.
subentry.2031.description: Manage tests which have been defined in System > Test definition, and classify them into test groups and test group categories.
subentry.2033.description: Provides comprehensive information about incoming and outgoing messages.
subentry.2051.description: Create new sites, or maintain administrative information for existing sites.
subentry.2052.description: Create new locations or maintain administrative information for existing locations, such as a unique name, description, nurse, manage, and phone number. You can also copy or edit existing locations.
subentry.2053.description: Create new HIS locations or edit existing HIS locations, such as room name and assigned beds.
subentry.2054.description: Define new workgroups or edit existing workgroup information, such as workgroup name, manager, and description.
subentry.2055.description: Create new user profiles or edit existing user profiles.
subentry.2068.description: Import location records from an external file.
subentry.2069.description: Import user information from an import file. You can import the file manually, or you can perform an automated import from a Human Resources Management System.
subentry.2081.description: Define material types used for each test, create new material definitions or view material details. Use this entry also to activate/deactivate a material definition record or edit an existing material definition.
subentry.2094.description: Create new device configurations or edit existing ones.
subentry.2096.description: Create new device comments or edit existing comments. If supported by the device type, predefined comments are available.
subentry.2097.description: Manage devices which are not connectable to the application (for manual QC result entry).
subentry.2136.description: Extend the single value determination of QC test results and allow the detection of multiple QC error trends and variations.
subentry.2138.description: Map individual tests with generic tests. Generic tests are used by devices that  support several test types but only use one QC test.
subentry.2148.description: Map individual tests with generic tests. Generic tests are used by devices that support several test types but only use one QC test.
subentry.2149.description: Use this component to map QC (Rili-BÄK) tests with system tests, change these definitions, and add new ones. You can also define the parameters for the Rili-BÄK quality control process.
subentry.2194.description: Manage user certificates for supported devices: define certificate details.
subentry.2199.description: Create notification templates for emails and letters, and notifications displayed on devices.
subentry.2203.description: Define the security used by devices when communicating with the application via WLAN.
subentry.2204.description: Assign EAP settings to devices. Assigned EAP settings are transferred to the device during the next synchronization.
subentry.2205.description: Create a report of the errors that occurred during the import of LMS exam results.
subentry.2212.description: View 2 types of messages: error messages about failed user import and information messages about user information changes.
subentry.2232.description: Allow the host to order a predefined selection of tests from a specific device type.
subentry.2260.description: Import and assign EAP settings from an external file into the application.
subentry.2264.description: Import devices from an import file.
